title: Cursor rule with alwaysApply false and no description or globs is never applied
symptoms: The rule is listed but Agent ignores it
The rule only takes effect when typed as an @-mention in chat
A globs rule applies only when a matching file is already in context
cause: With alwaysApply false, no description, and no globs, a rule becomes Apply Manually and loads only when @-mentioned. A rule with globs attaches only when a matching file is in context, and an agent-selected rule needs a description to be chosen.
fix: Set alwaysApply true for rules that must always load, give agent-selected rules a clear description, and check globs against the paths Agent actually opens.
apply:
---
description: RPC service conventions for the backend
globs: src/services/**/*.ts
alwaysApply: false
---
